title: Confined Space Entry Permit
name: Confined Space Entry Permit
description: Controlled confined-space entry covering isolation, atmospheric testing, communications and site-specific rescue.

fields.label: RAMS / Safe System of Work Reference

sections.title: HAZARDS AND ISOLATION
items: Entry is necessary and alternatives have been considered
Confined-space hazards have been assessed
Mechanical and electrical equipment is isolated where required
Pipework and process connections are isolated where required
Flooding and engulfment risks are controlled
Heat, residues and hazardous substances have been considered
Safe access and egress are available

sections.title: ATMOSPHERIC TESTING AND VENTILATION
items: Atmosphere has been tested before entry
Oxygen is within the entry limits defined by the assessment
Flammable atmosphere is within the specified entry limit
Toxic contaminants are within specified limits
Detector calibration / function check is current
Ventilation is suitable for the space and task
Ongoing monitoring frequency is defined

fields.label: Calibration / Bump Test Reference or Date

sections.title: ENTRY CONTROLS AND COMMUNICATION
items: Entrants are trained and competent
Attendant remains at the entry point
Communication has been tested
Entry and exit route suits casualty recovery
Required PPE and RPE have been checked
Lighting and electrical equipment are suitable
Entrants are signed in and out

sections.title: EMERGENCY AND RESCUE
items: A site-specific rescue plan is in place
Rescue does not rely solely on emergency services
Rescue personnel are trained and available
Rescue equipment is immediately available
Casualty retrieval suits the actual access route
Alarm and emergency communications have been tested
First-aid arrangements are available

sections.title: AUTHORIZATION AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Permit issuer has verified entry conditions
All entrants have exited and are accounted for
Tools and temporary equipment are removed or handed over
Space is secured against unauthorised re-entry
Changed conditions and defects are recorded
